name: Soyuz TM-6
about: Soyuz TM-6 (1988-075A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1988 Aug 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 Sep 28), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
